title: Finds usages of OSSpinlock, which is deprecated due to potential livelock problems.
summary: The check is deprecated. The check is in the darwin module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds declarations of dispatch_once_t variables without static or global storage.
summary: The behavior of using dispatch_once_t predicates with automatic or dynamic storage is undefined by libdispatch, and should be avoided. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the darwin module of clang-tidy.
